title: Emails: Anthropic sent bankers a copy of its IPO filing showing plans to raise up to ~$69B, then followed up saying the pricing details were inaccurate (Echo Wang/Reuters)
summary: Echo Wang / Reuters: Emails: Anthropic sent bankers a copy of its IPO filing showing plans to raise up to ~$69B, then followed up saying the pricing details were inaccurate — Anthropic sent out and then retracted details of its blockbuster IPO filing, according to emails to bankers seen by Reuters late on Monday.
